sources.citation: E-3DPSM: A State Machine for Event-Based Egocentric 3D Human Pose Estimation
sources.read_depth: full method + official selected source
sources.locator: Sections 3–4; Figure 2; code base.py 101–105, s5_model.py 324–325, learnable_kf.py 12–13,75,109
sources.original_assumptions: LNES; direct/delta fusion; bidirectional training/optional causal inference
sources.minimal_transfer: Only transfer distinct roles of state prediction and evidence correction; novelty overlap is strong
sources.failure_conditions: Dense input and bidirectional code require causal audit; learned variance is not automatically event-conditioned uncertainty
sources.additional_computation: S5 and second head plus filter; no locally measured cost
sources.falsifier: Change future input after a prefix and require emitted prefix predictions unchanged

sources.citation: EvHandPose: Event-Based 3D Hand Pose Estimation With Sparse Supervision
sources.read_depth: full method + official selected source
sources.original_assumptions: MANO mesh interpolation, first-hit surface and barycentric flow; LNES+ConvGRU
sources.minimal_transfer: Use mesh-induced flow as training constraint, not independent depth observation
sources.failure_conditions: State bias, occlusion, illumination; main representation is dense
sources.additional_computation: Multiple MANO evaluations, rasterization and flow encoder; unmeasured
sources.falsifier: Time-destroyed control preserves events and compute; reject temporal claim if gain remains

sources.citation: 3D Pose Estimation of Two Interacting Hands from a Monocular Event Camera (Ev2Hands)
sources.read_depth: full method + official selected source
sources.original_assumptions: Window event clouds; PointNet++; segmentation-conditioned feature attention
sources.minimal_transfer: Raw event points can predict MANO without unique event depth
sources.failure_conditions: Time coordinate is not metric Z; point-cloud batches are not necessarily asynchronous local updates
sources.falsifier: Count/polarity-preserving timestamp destruction

sources.citation: EventEgoHands++: Event-based Egocentric 3D Hand Mesh Reconstruction with Real Dataset
